title: Command Show Skin
description: Command Show Skin — Hides armor visuals via commands while fully preserving protection, stats, and compatibility with player model mods.
body:
# 🛡️ Command Show Skin

Ever wanted to show off your unique skin without sacrificing the protection of your diamond chestplate? **Command Show Skin** allows you to hide any piece of armor with a simple command while keeping all its stats, enchantments, and bonuses.

## ✨ Key Features
* **Total Invisibility**: **Hide/Show** your helmet, chestplate, leggings, or boots individually—or all at once.
* **Keep Your Stats**: Armor stays equipped and provides full protection even when visually **hidden/shown**.
* **Global Sync**: Your **Hide/Show** settings are instantly synced with other players—they see your skin, not your armor.
* **Smart Compatibility**: Featuring a "Render Guard" system, the mod correctly **hides/shows** armor even when using player model mods (like **Female Gender Mod**).

---

## 🎮 Commands
Manage your armor's visibility directly from the chat:

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/showskin all off/on` | **Hide/Show** all armor |
| `/showskin head off/on` | **Hide/Show** helmet |
| `/showskin chest off/on` | **Hide/Show** chestplate |
| `/showskin legs off/on` | **Hide/Show** leggings |
| `/showskin feet off/on` | **Hide/Show** boots |
